translations.web: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
translations.bsb: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
translations.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
translations.asv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore the scripture saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
